description: Caption chunk boundaries and emphasis by word index. Never times: the aligner owns timing.

beatId.description: A beat id from the cue sheet.

fromWord.description: First spoken word index in the beat (0-based).

toWord.description: Last spoken word index in the beat, inclusive.

text.description: The spoken words fromWord to toWord, in order. Punctuation and line breaks may change; words may not.

emphasis.description: Word indexes inside this chunk to emphasise. May be empty.

note.description: One short sentence for the reviewer, or empty.
